data.name: Plastic Battle Rush
data.detailed_description:
Plastic Battle Rush 2 is a fast-paced, team-based competitive FPS where the goal isn't just to outshoot the enemy, it’s to out-haul them. In this toy-themed arena, your value to the team is measured in the plastic you bank, but every piece you carry makes you a slower, easier target.

Steal, Haul, and Bank

Combat is only half the battle. To win, you must strip plastic from your opponents and deliver it to your team’s score poles. The team that controls the poles and manages their deposits effectively wins the exchange. Map control and timing are just as vital as a steady aim.

Risk vs. Reward: The Weight of Victory

Plastic is power, but it’s also heavy. The more plastic you carry, the bigger your potential score and the slower your movement speed becomes. Do you push for a massive, game-changing deposit while vulnerable, or play light and fast to chip away at the lead? Every piece is a choice between greed and survival.

One Shot, One Kill

Fights are deliberate, high-stakes, and lethal. A single shot is all it takes to drop an opponent (or be dropped yourself). This "one-shot" mechanic keeps the pace blistering and ensures that every encounter is readable and intense. No bullet sponges, just pure tactical execution.

Built for the "One More Round" Grind

With short, sharp rounds, Plastic Battle Rush 2 is designed for quick sessions and repeat play. Whether you have ten minutes or two hours, the gameplay loop is built to get you back into the action instantly.

Key Features

  • Tactical Team Play: Coordinate with your squad to protect your haulers or ambush theirs.

  • Dynamic Weight Mechanic: Strategic movement penalties based on your current plastic count.

  • Lethal Combat: High-stakes "one shot, one kill" gunplay that rewards precision.

  • Objective-Driven Rounds: Win through banking resources at poles, not just eliminations.

  • Fast-Paced Action: Short round timers designed for high-intensity matches.

data.short_description: Battle as plastic army men in this high-stakes team FPS. Steal plastic from rivals and haul it to your poles to bank the win. But beware: the more you carry, the slower you move. One shot, one kill. High-speed rounds. Toy-themed chaos. Steal it. Haul it. Bank it, or drop it.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 970 / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended. Keyboard and mouse required. Online multiplayer required.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit (or Windows 10 64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 (6 GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: None
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended. Stable internet connection required for online play.
